title: The NEXT Frontier: THESE 3 Stocks Boom
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: AI is shortening drug and therapy design (cancer vaccines, phage therapy) and is the next frontier for AI investing.

calls.condition: Binary on the Oct 24 phase-3 presentation: good readout could mean ~$300, bad readout back to ~$140.
calls.reason: Owns it (bought ~135-145); AI speeds personalized cancer-vaccine design and the Saturday Oct 24 phase-3 melanoma update with Merck is a catalyst. High single-trial risk: could be $300 or back to $140.
calls.quote: I personally am exposed to Moderna stock. I'm very excited about it.

calls.reason: 'S&P 500 of healthcare AI': acquisition machine with PEG ~1.9 and reasonable valuation; lowest-risk play in AI healthcare.
calls.quote: this I think is the lowest risk play, and I still think their valuation is reasonable

calls.reason: AI data/apps segment growing fastest with better margins, but not profitable until 2028; too early to call a winner, he doesn't own it.
